# streamFunctionCallArguments

common

val [streamFunctionCallArguments](stream-function-call-arguments.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)?

When true, a single function call's arguments are streamed across chunks (partialArgs) rather than returned all at once. Vertex-only; not supported by the Gemini Developer API.
